action.objective: Advance the f-pawn to contest Black's center and open lines for the rook on f1.
action.rationale: f2f4 is the only commit_ready move: exact score 35 at depth 2 with full safety verification (no mate-in-one, tactical refutation not_found). Broad search alternatives (e3e4, d1e2) scored higher but only at depth 1 with upper-bound rows and no verification, so they are not comparable. f2f4 gains space, supports a possible e4 push, and gives the f1-rook scope. No all-move forced mate exists.
